description: CALCULATION. Use this when you need the daily and weekly pace to close each numeric gap within target_days, with scenarios and labeled assumptions. This is a projection, not a prediction. Do not use it to learn the size of the gap (calculate_gap) or to list the rules (get_monetization_requirements).

inputSchema.description: CALCULATION tool. Required daily and weekly pace to close each numeric gap within target_days, with a linear scenario plus alternatives and labeled assumptions. A projection, never a prediction.

already_enrolled.description: Set true only if the creator is already enrolled in the Monetization Program. Default false: only entry (invitation) requirements are evaluated. When true, ongoing requirements for enrolled creators are reported in a separate section.

metrics.description: Metrics supplied by the caller (the creator or their agent). We never look metrics up ourselves; Snap offers no public analytics for arbitrary usernames. All fields optional; missing fields produce `unknowns`, never guesses. Data minimization: no age, birthdate, name, or username is accepted; creator age is never stored.

country.description: Country of residence. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (US), alpha-3 (USA), or the English name on the reviewed country map (United States). Unlisted territories stay unknown.

is_snap_star.description: Self-reported Snap Star status. Cannot be verified by us; treated as a user confirmation.

meets_age_requirement.description: Whether the creator meets the age requirement (18 or the local age of majority). true/false as stated by the caller; null = unknown and returns requires_user_confirmation. Data minimization: we never ask for or store a creator's age or birthdate.

spotlight_view_time_hours_28d.description: Spotlight view time in hours over the last 28 days.

view_time_hours_28d.description: Total view time in hours over the last 28 days, as shown in Snapchat Insights.

observed_daily_change.description: Optional recent average daily change per metric (caller-supplied, may be negative) for comparing required vs. current pace.

program.description: Programs the calculation tools evaluate in v1. Other in-scope programs (payouts, tax, snap_star, creator_monetization_policy, recommendation_eligibility, brand_partnerships) are served as FACTs by get_monetization_requirements; Snap Star status is evaluated as a prerequisite inside unified_monetization_program.
